subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：TIPDS（1,1,3,3-tetraisopropyldisiloxane-1,3-diyl）？
A. TBAF, THF
B. DIBAL-H, CH₂Cl₂, −78 °C
C. Piperidine, DMF
D. PPTS, MeOH
explanation: Bridges a 1,3-diol (classically 3′,5′ of a nucleoside) with a disiloxane; fluoride removes it.
